The Sympathizer is a traitor mask wholly unique compared to every other traitor mask. Sympathizers are counted as traitors for all intents and purposes, but they [bold]cannot tell who the other traitors are (and vice versa)[/bold] and [bold]cannot see the shared traitor objectives, besides the nuke.[/bold]
In exchange, [bold]command jobs can also roll Sympathizer[/bold]. This makes Sympathizer essentially 'traitor-lite', where you have an initial stage of deducing the traitors, and most of your traitorous actions are indirect; e.g., negotiating to get suspicious people out of prison, causing general chaos to cover for traitor activities, or defending the nuke when the time comes.
The potential existence of Sympathizers makes playing around traitors as crew a more nuanced process. Now, someone who might be acting evil--but otherwise has no gear and hasn't been seen sabotaging anything--could actually be a secret sympathizer and should be dealt with swiftly.
If you're being targeted by a traitor, be ready to scream as loud as you can about being a Sympathizer. Just don't expect them to always believe you.
